title: Conceptor Debiasing of Word Representations Evaluated on WEAT

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring cosine similarities of word embeddings using the Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT), specifically comparing target concept words (e.g., Career vs. Family, Math vs. Arts, Science vs. Arts) against male and female attribute words.

Measuring cosine similarities of word embeddings using the Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT), specifically comparing European American and African American names against pleasant and unpleasant attribute words.
